shadowSentences: I like to read books at night.
My favorite season is autumn every year.
I enjoy cooking new recipes on weekends.
Going for walks helps me clear my mind sometimes.
I often listen to music while I work.
Traveling brings me joy and new experiences.
I prefer coffee over tea in the morning.
Spending time outdoors is important for my well-being.
I usually plan my vacations well in advance every year.
Trying different cuisines from around the world is exciting.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: What was your last travel experience like?
Q2: What challenges do you face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about healthy eating.
questions: Q1: How do you usually maintain a healthy diet?
Q2: What are some difficulties you encounter with healthy eating?
Q3: Why do you think healthy eating is essential for everyone?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone trying to eat healthier?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What type of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: What challenges do you face in sticking to a workout routine?
Q3: In your opinion, how does exercise benefit mental health?
Q4: What recommendations do you have for someone starting to exercise?
